high_speaker_authority.rule: Only authoritative roles (Shipping Manager, Logistics Manager/Coordinator, Traffic Manager, Transportation Manager, Plant Manager, Warehouse/Dock Manager, Shipping Desk/Dept) can create VERIFIED operational claims. Non-authoritative roles (Reception / Gatekeeper, Operator, Security, Sales) create context-only evidence sources with is_primary_source=False, relationship='CONTEXT', mint 0 claims, and do not mutate facility operational columns or opportunity tiers.
implementation: Added AUTHORITATIVE_ROLES, AUTHORITATIVE_OTHER_ALLOWLIST, NON_AUTHORITATIVE_ROLES in src/backend/db/queries.py
Implemented is_role_authoritative_for_claims() helper
Non-authoritative path sets authority_status='NON_AUTHORITATIVE', records context-only evidence source, bypasses claim creation, appends clear audit note to outreach log
Frontend added id='gatekeeper-warning-banner' with reactive warning when non-authoritative role selected

medium_1_contact_facility_scope.rule: A contact belonging to sibling Facility B cannot be used as the verified source for Facility A. Contacts must belong to the target facility or corporate level (facility_id IS NULL). Departmental/desk outreach without a named contact remains supported.
implementation: Updated contact validation in src/backend/db/queries.py:log_outreach_call to check owning facility and company
Raises ValueError('Invalid contact: Contact belongs to a different facility') on sibling contact mismatch
FastAPI handles ValueError as HTTP 400 Bad Request
Permits company-level contacts (facility_id IS NULL) and facility-specific contacts (facility_id == target_facility_id)

medium_2_equipment_evidence_path.rule: Equipment evidence must follow canonical relational truth: no arbitrary INSERT of filler 'General Freight' commodity rows. If facility has exactly 1 commodity record, update equipment_category and equipment_usage_status='VERIFIED' and create claim. If 0 or >1 commodities exist, log explicit note without minting ambiguous claims.
implementation: Eliminated General Freight insert in src/backend/db/queries.py
Checked len(fac_comms) == 1 to target unambiguous facility commodity
Updates equipment_category and equipment_usage_status='VERIFIED' on facility_commodities without referencing non-existent updated_at column
Mints canonical facility_commodity claim with exact-1 FK constraint
Logs explicit audit note when commodities == 0 or > 1 without minting false claims

medium_3_duplicate_submission_idempotenc.rule: Rapid duplicate POST submissions must not create duplicate outreach logs or duplicate evidence sources.
implementation: Added client_request_id generation in src/frontend/templates/partials/log_call_modal.html resetForm()
Client disables submit button and guards submitCall() with saving flag
Backend indexes client_request_id in outreach_logs.notes as '[ClientRequestId: <token>]'
Server idempotency check searches recent outreach logs; if token matches, safely returns replay with is_duplicate_replay=True without inserting duplicate records

medium_4_interactive_browser_qa.rule: Execute a real interactive browser QA session with headless Chrome using Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) and capture evidence screenshots.
implementation: Created scripts/interactive_browser_qa.py running headless Chrome and temporary test database instance
Tested 6 full user flow stages with visual screenshots saved to reports/browser_qa_screenshots/
Verified modal open, Gatekeeper live warning banner, Shipping Manager fill, successful submission with Tier A recompute feedback, and clean cross-prospect form reset
